body: Kenney Fonts (CC0, fits the existing Kenney-only manifest schema) rejected: none of its 12 TTFs has a single Cyrillic code point (fontTools cmap scan of the pinned zip sha256 4e69a86e...), so it cannot render ПОТРАЧЕНО.

UI font = Inter 4.1 (SIL OFL 1.1, 248 Cyrillic glyphs) from the GitHub release zip, files Inter-Regular.ttf + InterDisplay-Black.ttf; the manifest schema gains an OFL license and a GitHub-release source rule. Rejected: Noto Sans release (117 MB zip), JetBrains Mono (monospace look), system-font fallback via bevy_text/system_font_discovery (OS-dependent, not reproducible).

Time<Virtual> stays at wasted_time_scale for the whole Wasted state (both WastedPhase::SlowMo and ::Screen) and returns to 1.0 only in OnExit(GameState::Wasted); the 1.5 s only delays the ПОТРАЧЕНО screen. Rejected: restoring 1.0 at the SlowMo->Screen switch, which makes the acceptance check 'slow-mo restores 1.0 on exit from Wasted' unfalsifiable (the exit restore could be deleted and the test would still pass).

Re-entry hazard fixed by keying one-shot spawns to OnTransition{exited: Loading, entered: Playing} (spawn_player in gta_sim, start_city_mesh_build in the client) instead of OnEnter(Playing); respawn keeps the same player entity. Rejected: a CityRendered guard resource (extra state) and despawn+respawn of the player (loses future weapon components). Probe: OnTransition fires once across Playing->Wasted->Playing.

Hospital respawn point = new pure citygen fn sidewalk_anchor(layout, params, building) (sidewalk midpoint of the building block's nearest non-alley side, same formula as player_spawn), not a new CityLayout field. Rejected: a layout field hashed into layout_hash (golden re-bless for 3 seeds and t2.py) — the point is a pure function of already-hashed layout+params.

Time<Virtual> restore: one system on OnExit(WastedPhase::SlowMo) (fires on SlowMo->Screen and on parent leaving Wasted, bevy_state transitions.rs:190-205) instead of V2 OnEnter(Screen)+OnExit(Wasted) duplicate whose second half cannot be flip-RED.

Hospital anchor: closest point on the geom::inset sidewalk ring side, clamped by margin = health.ron pickups.spacing, instead of V2 road-axis projection + perp offset with an unnamed margin; keeps both pickups on the same sidewalk segment.
Dead-player gate inserts Dead directly in Playing instead of walking through Wasted: common::run_ticks panics after count+4 updates and slow-mo yields ~1 tick per 3.3 updates.

D2.2 regen gate: added an off-grid case (damage 50.5 -> 49.5, 400 ticks, max <= 50) because the plan's 70 -> 30 path reaches 50.0 in exact 5/64 steps and stays GREEN with .min(cap) removed; alternative (rely on the unit table only) rejected, the integration gate must carry the flip itself.

E5 bad_license_source keyword 'page' (plan E4) stayed GREEN under an 'OFL accepts Kenney page' flip: the Kenney url '/media/pages/' makes any url error contain 'page'. Keyword tightened to 'OFL requires page'; flip now RED.

sidewalk_anchor resolves block nodes with .get() locally instead of making road_polygon fallible (review prescription): road_polygon also feeds sidewalks()/player_spawn on the golden-hash path, so a signature change would touch generation code for a helper-contract fix.
t5.py screenshot() deletes the target before the BRP capture and waits for a PNG signature, rather than unique file names: the owner-facing artifact names (wasted.png etc.) stay stable across runs.
